# `git_status`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] git_status`

Show the working tree status. Runs 'git status --short' in the working directory.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | no | Limit status to a specific path |
